validation: recomputed native action, arguments, and target digests
authenticated context, scope, purpose, policy, and request/correlation binding
durable execution and authority-instance canonical digests
no credentials, provider secrets, model prose, caller authority strings, or caller-trusted native hashes

identity.renewedApproval: same durable effect identity, different authority-instance digest while unclaimed

persistedAndChecksummed: represented principal, tenant, runtime, runtime instance, session
claim owner, generation, timestamp, and claim digest
horaeDurableBinding.corruptionBehavior: missing, truncated, replaced, or checksum-invalid state fails closed as a store error; it never authorizes execution

claim.verification: Horae persisted-state verifier port; Ananke never trusts caller-created claim flags
rejects: missing, fake, malformed, stale-owner, stale-generation, wrong execution, wrong action, wrong operation, wrong arguments, wrong authority, wrong adapter, and copied claims

ordering: authority envelope creation and durable Ananke authority put
Ananke exact authority and claim validation
single registered Ananke executor choke point
approval consumption only for terminal safe result
execution.executorPath: executeTool inside Gateway.executeClaimed only; Horae calls the structural Ananke binding and never invokes an effect adapter directly
execution.reconciliation: Gateway.reconcileClaimed calls only the adapter reconcile method and never the executor path

effectReceipt.confirmationRule: executor return or arbitrary success text is not confirmation; exact checksum-valid receipt or authoritative reconciliation is required
effectReceipt.providerIdempotency: future-provider abstraction derives a stable key from durable execution ID and adapter identity/version; unavailable provider deduplication remains UNKNOWN

effectTruth.CONFIRMED: exact authenticated/checksummed receipt or authoritative reconciliation proves the effect
effectTruth.ABSENT: authoritative reconciliation proves the exact effect did not occur
effectTruth.UNKNOWN: receipt/effect truth cannot be proven; automatic redispatch is blocked
effectTruth.unknownToConfirmed: real cross-Fate restart test: execute count 1, Horae recovery claim generation 2, Ananke reconcileClaimed, terminal CONFIRMED, execute count remains 1
effectTruth.absentNextStep: old uncertain identity remains closed/terminal; any future attempt requires fresh authority and a fresh Horae claim

crashMatrix.A_after_admission_before_claim: Horae authority_validated intent persists; Ananke binding is not called; no executor
crashMatrix.B_after_horae_claim_before_ananke: claim persists with owner/generation; no Ananke call until valid recovery
crashMatrix.C_after_reservation_before_invocation: Ananke state is durable reserved; resumed valid claim can make the one invocation, with no blind duplicate
crashMatrix.D_after_invocation_start: invocation_started is durable; recovery reconciles and does not invoke again
crashMatrix.E_effect_before_receipt_persistence: missing receipt is UNKNOWN/reconciliation-required after restart; no blind redispatch
crashMatrix.F_receipt_before_response: terminal receipt survives response loss; replay returns stored state and executor count remains one
crashMatrix.G_recovery_race: cross-process owner/generation arbitration leaves one winner and loser without a second effect invocation
